leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a reactive state variable that synchronizes with localStorage
Implement a custom composable function that manages localStorage interactions
Apply the useLocalStorage composable to persist form input data across page reloads
Configure a Vue component to automatically update localStorage when reactive state changes
Construct a user preferences panel where settings persist in the browser
Integrate localStorage error handling for quota exceeded and disabled storage scenarios
Manipulate stored data by implementing clear and reset functionality within a Vue application
